description.narrative: Huvudsyftet med denna förenklade insats är att underlätta genomförandet av den nationella planen för avrinningsområden III (dvs förvaltningsplanen för vattenresurser) och initieringen av den socioekonomiska utvecklingsplanen 2021-2025, genom i) att stärka sektorsövergripande mekanismer, såsom institutionella, finansiella, territoriella och övervakning (genom den konsoliderade ’Arbetsgruppen för avrinningsområden’); ii) utveckling av viktiga strategiska studier.

The main objective of this simplified contribution is to facilitate the implementation of the National Watershed Plan III (Water Resources Management Plan) and the initiation of the Socio-Economic Plan 2021-2025, through i) the strengthening of inter-sectoral, institutional, financial, territorial, and monitoring mechanisms (through the consolidated Watershed Roundtable platform); ii) the development of key strategic studies.

The main objective of this simplified contribution is to facilitate the implementation of the National Watershed Plan III (Water Resources Management Plan) and the initiation of the Socio-Economic Plan 2021-2025, through i) the strengthening of inter-sectoral, institutional, financial, territorial, and monitoring mechanisms (through the consolidated Watershed Roundtable platform); ii) the development of key strategic studies.
Three specific objectives have been established: • To support in close coordination with the Ministry of Water and Environment and the Vice ministry of Water Resources (VRHR ), the Basin Donor Table (MDC) and the Technical Assistance Sub-table (SUBAT), with the aim i) to promote the consolidation of National Watershed Plan III (PNC III), ii) to harmonize the collaboration between the International Cooperation Agencies and MMAYA´s vice ministries (drinking water and sanitation; water resources; environment) and iii) to include an intersectoral set of actors at the national and local levels under the guidelines of the Socio Economic Development Plan 2021 -2025 (axis 8: sustainable and balanced environment with protection of mother earth ) with a focus on Water and Environment. • To carry out the update of the Water Balance (BHB) of Bolivia 2017-2020 and initiate an approach for groundwater integration making this information available for territorial development planning. •To establish the guidelines of the Bolivia WATCH Program and its potential second phase in alignment with the Swedish Strategy for Development Cooperation in Bolivia 2021-2025, and PDES 2021-2025 with a focus on operationalize the basin master plans with economic empowerment, preservation of ecosystems and biodiversity, equity and inclusiveness.

The first component aimed to support the Embassy to assume the co-leadership of the Watershed Roundtable and its respective Technical Assistance Sub-table. Among the main results regarding the Watershed RoundTable, it can be mentioned its formal reactivation, increasing the number of participants to key stakeholders such as the multilateral Bank (World Bank, CAF, IDB). During this short period and even with the high turn over among the staff within the Viceministry of Watershed and Irrigation, the project along with VRHR has been able to develop an agenda oriented to support the implementation of the PPRH and to take initial step regarding the development of a financial strategy to finance it. Regarding the Technical Assistance Sub-Table, three technical commission around the pillars of the PPRH have been established and have begun with regular meetings.
Regarding the second component, the Hydrological Balance for superficial water has been updated, providing a description of the climatic and hydrological conditions. The developed model provides a baseline of the countries water resources so policymakers can plan better and more efficient public policies. SEI has also created a platform in its Water Evaluation and Planning System (WEAP) that contains information about all available water supply in Bolivia, using data from field measurements and satellite records. It has been done under a participatory approach with the collaboration of Bolivia´s Ministry of the Environment and Water (MMAYA), the Institute of Hydraulic and Hydrology from the San Andrés University, and the Laboratory of Hydrology from the University of San Simón. Additionally, it has developed a conceptual model of Groundwater, laying the basis for cooperation to develop further research in this topic. Finally, it has supported SENAHMI developing protocols for the processing and provision of key data (a huge institutional weakness that has caused delays to develop the Water Balance at the beginning).
Concerning the third component, the main results has been the transfer of the toolbox to the Watershed Viceministry VRHR including the strengthening of technical capacities among its staff for its regular use. It is expected that this toolbox will be institutionalized laying the ground to be a key instrument for the implementation of the PPRH in the next periods.
Additionally, this simplified contribution has achieved an additional result. In response to a specific request from the Vice Ministry of Foreign Affairs, an initial diagnosis of water resources and water pollutions problems have been made in the Madidi Region. A Water balance has been made, including an initial mapping of the potential financial sources to implement an integrated resource water management initiatives in the region. Based on this information, SEI is now part of the Sustainable Gold Initiative promoted by the Legislative Assembly, expecting that this information will be used as a key instrument for further cooperation in the future.
